analysis: The trial executed successfully but did not improve validation: pinned-host macro HR@10 was 0.5500, below the referenced 0.5650 R-Drop result by 0.0150 and 0.5737 reference by 0.0237. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.5600, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.6100, Electronics 0.4350, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.5950. Adding two-step supervision at weight 0.2 therefore did not support the broader-intent hypothesis in this configuration. It may introduce competing objectives or noisier targets, but this result alone does not establish the cause. No held-out test conclusions are available.
code_summary: One independently trained GRURec checkpoint per category, with normalized item embeddings, a two-layer GRU, causal attention over preceding recurrent states, learned relative-distance bias, projection, gated item-identity residual, and learned item biases. Training retains two-pass BPR-max with 64 sampled negatives and symmetric R-Drop, adding 0.2 times two-step BPR-max averaged across the same passes. Auxiliary labels remain within unchanged training windows; auxiliary-positive collisions are masked and negative weights renormalized. Seed 42, supplied splits, validation selection, and category routing are preserved. Prediction loads one selected checkpoint per category and uses one deterministic forward pass.
